observationsNotFindings.observation: The top-level passProperty still gates executability on 'the twelve FC implementations', while after the B1 repair only eleven classes supply retained-evidence members; FC-REMEDIATION supplies none.
observationsNotFindings.whyNotCharged: The statement remains true rather than false: if all twelve exist, every member's passProperty does hold, because the eleven that supply members are among them. The antecedent is simply stronger than the members require, which blocks longer rather than admitting anything. That is the opposite of the defect this reviewer charged on the same structural surface at G09 v2, where the gate asserted a sufficiency that was false and opened a path to declaring executability with members unevidenced. A conservative gate creates no false-pass path, and namedCorpusNotAuthored naming twelve is independently correct because that field carries doctor-contract.v4's corpus, not this harness's consumption set. Recorded because a later revision could tighten the gate to the eleven that supply members, and because FC-REMEDIATION's own passProperty requires populated remediation records, so its authoring is not available while DR-114 or DR-103 is open — a dependency worth naming if the gate is ever restated.
